description: Localized deeper swelling of the skin or mucosa caused by increased vascular permeability; it may be allergic, drug-related, idiopathic, or hereditary.
symptoms: Itching may occur in histamine-mediated forms

appearance.general: Sudden deeper swelling, commonly affecting lips, eyelids, face, tongue, hands, feet, or genital areas.

warning_signs: Tongue or throat swelling, difficulty breathing, voice change, or faintness is an emergency.
general_first_aid: Seek emergency care immediately when breathing or airway symptoms occur.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss triggers, medication exposure, family history, and whether episodes occur with or without hives.
